layout_observed: Red Bull Ring F1 10-corner layout; exclude MotoGP-only chicane at approximately823m.
lighting_weather_observed: Predominantly wet/overcast with low cloud over wooded hills.
review_scope: 16 sparse overview frames viewed by author. Clip is an edited career/race montage, includes menus/cuts and changing conditions; not a continuous lap. Unviewed timestamps are not evidence.

reviewed_visual_evidence.notes: Main straight and Niki Lauda T1: Long red-seated covered main stand opposite tiered glazed pits. Outside T1 hillside grandstand; broad red/white kerbs and corner-specific painted/asphalt escape beyond steep grass banks.

Uphill to Remus T3: Steep uphill road with conifer woodland and grass embankments, outside open bleachers at hairpin. Wide red-painted/red-white escape apron at braking zone; no F1 chicane midway up.

Downhill Schlossgold T4: Strong downhill grade and open valley views; forests beyond. Infield Red Bull bull-and-ring sculpture visible offset from track; wide corner-specific runoff and barriers on elevated banks.

Rauch and Würth middle corners: Sweeping downhill curves bordered by grass, red/white kerbs, gravel/asphalt outside and open hillside spectator seating. Conifer ridges frame the entire view.

Rindt and Red Bull Mobile: Fast descending right-hand finish sequence; pit and main-stand roofs across valley. Green outer strips, red/white kerbs and a limited orange/black raised kerb element near pit entry.
